Gull Landings – Residence #104 Waterfront Luxury • Private Dock • Two Panoramic Marina Terraces
Experience premier marina-front living at Gull Landings Condo #104, a rare offering that blends luxury, privacy, and unmatched views of the Erie Basin Marina. This first-level residence delivers a coveted combination of lifestyle amenities and renovation potential—ideal for buyers seeking both elegance and opportunity.
Property Highlights
 • Deeded Boat Dock Enjoy effortless access to the water—step out, cast off, and return to your private slip just moments from your door.
 • Heated Underground Garage Parking Secure, climate-controlled parking ensures year-round comfort and convenience.
 • Two Expansive Exterior Deck Areas Both outdoor spaces overlook the Erie Basin Marina, offering sweeping water views, sunrise and sunset backdrops, and exceptional entertaining potential.
 • Open-Concept Living & Dining Large windows frame the marina, filling the home with natural light and creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection.
 • Master Suite Opportunity The primary bath is currently down to the studs—a rare chance to design and finish a custom spa-quality retreat tailored to your exact style and specifications.
 • Waterfront Lifestyle Walkable to Buffalo’s vibrant waterfront, Canalside, restaurants, bike paths, and seasonal events.
Condo #104 presents a unique blend of established luxury and customizable potential—perfect for the buyer who wants a premier marina-front residence with the freedom to elevate the master suite into something extraordinary.
